documents.title: Listing of Equity Shares of Baheti Recycling Industries Ltd

analysis.summary: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited reported a strong start for H1 FY27, with revenue growing by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores and PAT increasing by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores. Supported by increasing demand and capacity enhancements, management revised its FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores while maintaining its margin trajectory. The company is expanding its Aluminium Wire Rod division in phases on existing owned land to reach a total capacity of 25,000 MT. Additionally, the company received in-principle approval from both NSE and BSE for its proposed migration from the SME platform to the Main Board. Baheti Recycling reported a strong performance for FY26 with revenue rising to 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores, driven by improved operational efficiency and margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we have revised our FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores, while maintaining our existing margin trajectory.

guidance.claim: The company targets to ramp up capacity utilization to full capacity by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Management targets Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod plant to achieve around 12,500 metric tons per annum with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores.
guidance.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd croresIn phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons.

guidance.claim: In Phase 2 of the wire rod plant, revenue will increase by another 250-odd crores for a total revenue of around 500-odd crores.
guidance.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores. So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company is heading into FY27 with a minimum order of 200 crores, excluding the aluminum wire rod plant.
guidance.quote: We are heading into FY27 with an order of Minimum 200 crores with us. And there are a lot of excitement development. This is excluding order book or the plant of aluminum wire rod.

guidance.claim: Management expects utilization for the Phase 1 aluminum wire rod plant to reach around 70% in FY28.
guidance.quote: FY28 will be reaching somewhere around 70-odd percentage.

guidance.claim: Management expects sustainable EBITDA margins in the industry to be between 7% to 10%.
guidance.quote: See, the EBITDA margin in our industry is a sustainable EBITDA margin which we are working on. So anywhere between 7 to 10% is very it's quite sustainable EBITDA margin in our kind of industry

guidance.claim: The company is confident in exceeding a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growth is supported by increasing demand and a growing presence across key industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Over the past few quarters, our confidence in the Company's growth prospects has strengthened, supported by increasing demand, capacity enhancements and a growing presence across key industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted by geopolitical tension in the Middle East, pushing customers towards reliable secondary sources.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: The company added many automotive clients in March and H2 directly to OEMs like Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor, and Royal Enfield.
demand_outlook.quote: We have also added many automotive clients in the month of March in H2 directly to the OEMs like Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor, Royal Enfield.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary aluminum is cheaper compared to primary aluminum by 7 to 10% in terms of alloys.
demand_outlook.quote: See, in terms of aluminum alloy, the primary and secondary aluminum difference ranges between 7 to 10 %, and secondary aluminum is cheaper as compared to primary aluminum.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic scrap is about 7-8% more expensive than imported scrap.
demand_outlook.quote: No, no not that much, to be very honest. We have not compared, but you can say 7-8% would be expensive.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 crores as it steps into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding the Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing owned land in two phases to reach a total capacity of 25,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: A key priority for us is the expansion of our Aluminium Wire Rod division, where we are expanding our capacity on our existing owned land in two phases. Over time, we intend to have a total wire-rod capacity of 25,000 MT, representing a revenue opportunity of approximately ₹500 crores annually.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod expansion has an investment of ₹20-25 crores and is to be live by Q4FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: PPPHHHAAASSSEEE 111 PPPHHHAAASSSEEE 222 12,500MT 25,000MT Investment Annual Revenue Potential Incremental Operating (Phase 1) (Full Capacity) Margins from total capacity ₹20-25Cr. ₹500Cr. 1-2%

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25-odd crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod plant is expected to be commissioned by the end of October or early November.
capex_expansion.quote: By the end of October, you can say early November.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod project requires a maximum of 5 crores for putting up the furnace and associated equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20–25 crores in FY27 to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod division aims to scale capacity to 25,000 MT with a revenue potential of ₹500 crores annually.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total smelting capacity has reached 38,000 MT with five more furnaces lined up for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations grew by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores, while EBITDA increased by 99.48% to ₹42.37 crores and PAT grew by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations grew by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores, while EBITDA increased by 99.48% to ₹42.37 crores and PAT grew by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin is projected to improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business with the new wire rod product.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin will improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.

margins_costs.claim: The cost of production increased by 15% because of fuel prices due to the war situation.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The captive solar plant is expected to run by the end of May 2026 to cut power costs on electric furnaces, with margin benefits starting from Q2 onwards.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

orders_capacity.claim: With the addition of the new electrical furnaces and solar plant, total installed capacity will stand at 38,000 tons annually.
orders_capacity.quote: With this addition, our total installed capacity will stand to 38,000 tons annually.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current capacity utilization is 60%.
New clients including TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, and Bajaj Auto have been added for direct OEM supply.
orders_capacity.quote: This year, we added some clients we are genuinely proud of - TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, Bajaj Auto- all of whom are now being supplied directly for their automotive requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: The company actively focused on reducing debt and improving key financial ratios during FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Furthermore, company’s actively focused on Reducing the debt and improving the key financial ratio.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹7.48 crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy.
capital_allocation.quote: We also raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy as volumes grow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Imported raw material accounts for around 80% of total raw material.
Pressure on primary aluminium availability is real due to Middle East disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.
